privacyBody: SnapMatch is being developed to help guests find their photos within a single event. Before camera access, guests will be asked for consent. Selfies will be processed in memory for matching and will not be saved. Event face data will expire on the date shown for that event. Photos will be private, and guests will receive access only to their matched photos. A removal option will be provided. Contact details, retention rules, legal basis and processor information must be completed before launch.

faqs.a: SnapMatch is a workspace for event photographers and photography businesses managing multiple shoots, large photo collections and client handovers.

faqs.q: What kinds of events can I manage?
faqs.a: Corporate events, conferences, concerts, weddings, birthdays and more. Each event has its own details, photographs and delivery settings.
Select or drop in your JPEGs and follow the progress of each file. If an upload is interrupted, select the same files again to resume without duplicating completed uploads.

faqs.q: Can I control original downloads and watermarks?
faqs.a: Yes. Set download permissions and watermark preferences for each event. Choose the watermark setting before uploading so the processed collection stays consistent.

faqs.q: Can I print a QR code for an event?
faqs.a: Yes. Each event has a link, a downloadable QR PNG and a printable A5 poster containing the event details.
